name: cargopulse-monorepo
description: CargoPulse - End-to-End Supply Chain Visibility & Logistics Management Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,WEB" -c "blue,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
